skills.name: wewrite
skills.description: WeWrite 一键写作主流程：接收已创建 run，按 topic/write/review 步骤产出 brief/claims/draft/article/report，审稿通过才 ready

skills.name: wewrite-topic
skills.description: 选题与主题构思（从工作台热榜与主题目录中选题，按 topic-selection 规则评分并确定写作角度）

skills.name: wewrite-write
skills.description: 正文写作流程（brief → claims → draft → article，全部经 wewrite_artifact_write 落盘，含任务书、主张与证据、素材与初稿）

skills.name: wewrite-review
skills.description: 审稿流程（五维评估 → wewrite_review → 通过后 wewrite_run_finish，含事实核对、改稿与成稿门禁）

skills.name: wewrite-visual
skills.description: 可选视觉流程（默认 visualMode=none；cover/full/prompts 按需启用，生成封面与内文配图或只交付提示词）

skills.name: wewrite-publish
skills.description: 预览与请求草稿推送（本地预览 + 预检 + 逐篇确认请求；不真实推送到微信）
